_comment: Pin for the Tier 0 VTK-wasm spike (doc/roadmap.md Tier 0). The URL path 'dist/latest' is BRANCH 'dist', path 'latest/...' on github.com/Kitware/vtk-wasm — not a branch literally named 'dist/latest'. 'ref' is that branch's HEAD commit at fetch time, resolved via `git ls-remote https://github.com/Kitware/vtk-wasm.git`. fetch-vtk-wasm.mjs refuses to unpack a download whose sha256 does not match this file, so a later push to the dist branch cannot silently invalidate a measurement already written into doc/vtk-wasm-spike.md.

loader._comment: The npm loader package (loadAsync/StandaloneSession, no wasm binary). Vendored into out/vtk-wasm/loader/ rather than added to package.json/package-lock.json — this is throwaway spike scaffolding, not a shipped dependency, and it may be dropped.
